snippet.title: Tape 101 - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the creepy Tape 101 trailer for this psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real. Tape 101 will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
